_comment: The joystick is on the arrow keys, A on X, B on Z, Option 1 on A, Option 2 on S and Pause on Return. Power ships unbound.

The keys are also on the first game controller: the directional pad and the left stick are the joystick, A is A, B is X, Option 1 is the left shoulder, Option 2 the right one, and Start is Pause (chimera#336).
On a link machine P1 is where it is on one Lynx, and each other player's keys are on that player's game controller (P2 on the second, and so on). Each Power and Toggle Link Connection ship unbound.
